definitions.explanation: The standard or grade of excellence of a product or manufactured good.

examples.japanese: {品質|ひんしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
{品質|ひんしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：01996_tamotsu⟧。
⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。だけど、{品質|ひんしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's expensive. But the quality is good.

notes:
{品質|ひんしつ} refers to the quality of products or goods.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {品質|ひんしつ}{管理|かんり}: quality control
- {品質|ひんしつ}{保証|ほしょう}: quality assurance
- {高|こう}{品質|ひんしつ}: high quality

CONTRAST WITH {質|しつ}:
- {品質|ひんしつ}: specifically product quality
- {質|しつ}: quality in general (sleep, life, etc.)
